evidence.note: Found foundational bug (all versions share one data file); rather than local patch, grepped every get_bucket_object_data_path call site and propagated version-scoped paths across put/copy/multipart/lifecycle — class-wide correction on a falsified storage assumption.
Root-caused misrouting to query.get() treating empty-string params as falsy; revised the whole class of checks to 'param in query' rather than fixing one route.

Multipart empty-file failure diagnosed to true root cause (boto3 XML default namespace defeats findall); recognized it affects all XML parsing, added a namespace-stripping helper and applied it to every ET.fromstring site — treats divergence as signal and propagates the fix.
After code inspection, corrected policy method-to-action mapping and a get_bucket_total_bytes bug reading size from the wrong dict level — targeted root-cause fixes, not random tweaks.

reasoning: The agent repeatedly diagnoses failures to their actual root cause (namespace-aware XML parsing, falsy empty-string query params, shared version data paths) and, crucially, propagates each correction across all affected subsystems by grepping for every call site rather than patching only the failing case — matching the level-8 anchor and edging toward 10. It falls short of a clean 10 because updates to verification/plan to prevent recurrence are implicit and there is little evidence of deep SigV4-canonicalization-level divergence hunting, the marquee hard-mismatch case.
